_note: Role cards. Every agent is defined the same way: purpose, sources, tier, autonomy, handover. Adding an agent means adding a card here.

agents.name: Router (front door)
agents.purpose: Identify who is asking, pick the agent, and lock the request to that person's access tiers.
agents.tier: Reads no knowledge; sets the tier for others
agents.autonomy: Routes on its own. Escalates below the confidence threshold or on structural, contractual or dispute topics.

agents.name: Capture agent
agents.purpose: Turn voice notes, photos, dockets and messages into text and candidate facts.
agents.tier: Writes candidates only; nothing is stored until approved
agents.autonomy: Full, because its output is never shown to anyone outside without review

agents.name: Curator agent
agents.purpose: Bind each item to a job, check it against the approved documents, flag conflicts, and draft knowledge updates.
agents.tier: All tiers, to compare; drafts carry the tier they belong to

agents.name: Teamwork agent (SiteBrain)
agents.purpose: Give site staff and trades drawing-grounded answers and build certifier inspection packs.
agents.tier: Customer-safe and public; never internal pricing
agents.handover: Founder for any deviation from the drawings

agents.name: Commercial agent (claims, variations, procurement)
agents.purpose: Prepare progress claim packs, draft written variations, and code supplier invoices.
agents.tier: Internal for coding; customer-safe for anything sent to clients or lenders
agents.autonomy: Drafts; never commits money or scope
agents.handover: Founder for every variation and any amount it cannot match

agents.name: Content agent
agents.purpose: Turn approved site moments into posts in the founder's voice.
agents.autonomy: Drafts; founder signs off every post
